description: Fires triggers around a set rate, with each interval lengthened or shortened by a random amount

params.text: Sets the average rate, as a power of two in hertz, from about 0.004Hz to 256Hz
Sets how far each interval strays from the set rate, 0 to 100 per cent of it
Sets how many channels the output carries, 1 to 16; each trigger goes to one of them, chosen at random

inputs.text: Sets the deviation of each interval from an outside signal in place of the module's own random draw, -5V to 5V, read once per interval
Sets the rate by voltage in place of the Frq knob, as a power of two in hertz
Sets the deviation by voltage in place of the Dev knob, 0-10V mapped onto 0 to 100 per cent
A trigger here fires the next trigger at once and starts the timing again from there

outputs.text: A 10ms trigger on one channel at a time

notes: the module free-runs, so triggers come out as soon as it is placed with nothing patched

inputs.0:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads a triangular random draw.
inputs.1:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the Frq knob.
inputs.2:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the Dev knob; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.3: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
